title: Director-Liability-Reduction Laws and Conditional Conservatism

scopes.description: All supplied SAS preparation and companion Stata law-indicator code for the author-described workflow. Code_1 and Code_2 form ordered SAS preparation branches; Code_3 is a partial Stata robustness-code companion.

issues.description: The README calls Code_2 regression analysis and the datasheet says SAS and Stata perform all analyses, but the supplied Code_2 content prepares WORK datasets and ends at comments to export each branch to Stata. It contains no executable export commands or estimators. Code_3 assigns five law indicators but has no import, dataset handoff, or estimation driver. The appendix documents reported tables/checks whose estimation programs are not supplied. The resulting full workflow and required output mapping cannot be closed from this package.

evidence.description: The appendix documents multiple validation and specification analyses.
evidence.quote:
We report several validation and specification checks in this Appendix. Our results are

robust to (1) using Byzalov and Basu’s [2016] asymmetric timeliness of accruals model, (2)

controlling for the enactment of antitakeover laws and state-level macroeconomic characteristics,

(3) the placebo test suggested by Patatoukas and Thomas [2016], (4) including additional firm

characteristics as controls, (5) multiple alternative sample-selection criteria, (6) self-selection for

state of incorporation, and (7) including state-specific linear time trends in the fixed effects

structure of equation (3). We also verify the parallel trends assumption for our setting.

actions.description: Resolve the exact author-prepared SAS tables or verify compatible underlying products and mappings. Treat each source as a separate input: Compustat financial data; CRSP monthly returns and market returns; Compact Disclosure; 10-K/IRRC state records; Mergent pre-1989 changes; 13F ownership; Bushee classifications; pre/post-1990 G-index; and auditor data. Keep unknown author extraction and periods explicit.
steps: Locate each exact author-prepared conserv.* table, or document a compatible source-product-to-table mapping, including keys, fields, units, versions, and coverage.

Use COMP.FUNDA plus COMP.COMPANY only as the Compustat accounting/current-company source components; retain the distinct historical Compact Disclosure, 10-K/IRRC, and Mergent mapping. Do not apply current Company incorporation to all historical years.

The CRSP.MSF date-to-month key is ordinary preparation supported by Code_1’s companion market-index conversion; build the same YYYYMM key in a prepared copy and confirm it matches CRSP.MSI without changing returns or sample definitions.

For historical incorporation, resolve `cd_inc` by CUSIP/fyear, `tk_inc` by CIK/fyear, and Mergent `incorpo` by CIK/year_end; verify state codes, year-boundary rules, and source coverage. The local RISK.GSET file is a candidate for the 1990–2006 IRRC state component, while the exact `tk_inc` composition and 1989 rows remain unresolved.

For the 10-K component, the current SRAF 10-X header route covers 1993–2025 and supplies a state-of-incorporation field; confirm the CIK/fiscal-year/form selection and supply a compatible 1989–1992 source. Local SEC/LM path checks did not verify content or coverage.

For ownership, confirm the study’s 2016 13F and Bushee classification vintages, manager key and version handling, INSTOWN_PERC/dshare/shrout definitions, units, and date alignment. Do not treat the current 2026 classification file or a raw holdings table as the author-prepared outputs without that mapping.

For G-index, locate both distinct pre-1990 Cremers and post-1990 ISS inputs and resolve `gmissing` and the described collection-year expansion; do not substitute a governance table lacking that field.
For auditor analysis, locate the separate annual Compustat `au` extract or verify a same-product source mapping for `gvkey/fyear/au`.
validation: Use bounded metadata/readability probes on exact located files and compare actual source fields against the expected_fields listed on each requirement.

After a future authorized run, validate required period/identifier coverage, CIK/CUSIP/GVKEY joins, 12-month return windows, and Code_2 filters; one-row reads alone do not establish full history/population.

review_notes: This expanded checkpoint was built from the complete author documentation/programs plus bounded catalog, one-row SAS, directory-existence, current author/repository-page, and CIK-list checks. It does not execute author code or reconstruct estimators.

Code_2 requires Code_1’s WORK comp and return tables in the same SAS session. Its comments promise export-to-Stata handoffs, but it contains no executable transfer or regression code. Code_3 is substantial Stata indicator-construction code; it has no data import or estimator, and its first single slash may require comment normalization when packaged as a .do file.

The CIK list has 1,735 identifiers plus its `cik` header and is not a firm-year analysis dataset. No analysis_only scope is supported because no prepared analysis dataset or working export/input route is included.

Catalog-listed COMP.FUNDA/COMP.COMPANY, CRSP.MSF/CRSP.MSI, and RISK.GSET were readable in bounded row_limit=1 probes. The probes establish columns/readability only.
